subject: integration DELTA9: extracted audit ready but production rasterSamples compile error blocks run
body: One thermal run. Candidate PASS (manifest6d83446e2db357de, cdylib3f2d275a), 939 checks / 2 required, both same production compile failure: render_pipeline.inc:1125-1126 uses undeclared rasterSamples; native frontend + ASan variant-thread harness cannot compile, so extracted selector audit could not execute. This is current working-tree render/texture code, not integration. Minimal fix: define/derive rasterSamples from the descriptor before the RENDER_REQUIRE (or restore the intended variable), then rerun. Extracted audit artifacts are ready: 132 mapped CA/RB→Metal selectors, 5 unreachable CA::Fence cases, 2551 unclassified; all 141 default.metallib functions enumerated, 135 specialize with default constants, 6 fixed_* nil due required fc_* constants. Artifacts in workers/integration_tests: delta9_selectors.{inc,json}, delta9_metallib_functions.json, delta9_extract_selectors.py, delta9_frontend_audit.inc. No loop rerun, no phone/native/commit; HEAVY RELEASE integration_tests now.
